tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: App background behind every dashboard view.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, side panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, inputs at rest, neutral status chips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, table rules, card borders. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface-card).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-page, surface-card and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, company meta, helper text (4.5:1 on surface-card).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button. The dashboard is monochrome, so the main action is ink, not a hue.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action.

tokens.name: brand-forest
tokens.usage: Brand surfaces only: the app icon, the marketing site, the sign-in panel. Not used for dashboard UI.

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: The mark and wordmark on brand-forest; the warm ground of marketing pages.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: The win. The p's tail in the logo, the Offer status and the last piece of the progress mark. Never decorative; never text on light grounds. Put ink on it.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold as text, for the Offer label on light grounds (5.9:1 on surface-card).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px outside the control.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing headlines and empty-state hero lines.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Company and role names in lists.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in tables.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters and section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the app icon at small sizes, marketing tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and the bullseye dot.
